topic: Auditing net worth yearly vs never tracking (Nate vs Daisy)

scenes.narration: Tracking net worth yearly grows it six times faster. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard labeled NET WORTH SCALE, comic burst banner reads SIX TIMES FASTER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nate and Daisy are both thirty five and earn eighty thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man nate and woman daisy at matching desks each holding paychecks reading EIGHTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: They have both worked for a decade with no real money plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both nate and daisy holding ten year work badges, an empty financial plan sheet between them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nate has never added up his assets and debts on paper.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nate on a couch with bills scattered around, a question mark over a piggy bank icon, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He has no idea if he is moving forward or backward.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nate standing at a crossroads sign labeled FORWARD and BACKWARD with question marks above him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Daisy fills a one page net worth sheet every January.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, daisy at a kitchen table with a printed sheet labeled NET WORTH JANUARY, calendar showing January, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She lists every account, every debt, and every asset she owns.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of daisy's net worth sheet with two clean columns labeled ASSETS and DEBTS, items listed neatly, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Five years later Nate owes twenty thousand more than he owns.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked nate looking at a calculator showing NEGATIVE TWENTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He has been losing ground every year and never noticed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a downward red arrow line chart on a wall behind nate, comic banner reads UNDERWATER FIVE YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Daisy's net worth has grown sixty thousand over the same period.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, daisy holding a chart labeled SIXTY THOUSAND POSITIVE GROWTH, a rising green line, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tracking made every bad month obvious early enough to fix.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, daisy at a kitchen table circling a small dip on her chart with a red pen, comic banner reads CAUGHT EARLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Track net worth on one page every January. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding up a chart with a rising net worth line, comic burst banner reads SEE YOU NEXT VISIT, kids comic book illustration
